mapper.select: SELECT o.org_id, o.parent_org_id, o.org_name, o.org_index, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.state = 'A' THEN rel.user_id END) AS member_count, CASE WHEN t.org_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS attached FROM byai.po_organization o LEFT JOIN byai.po_users_organization rel ON rel.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN byai.po_users u ON u.user_id = rel.user_id LEFT JOIN byai.tenant_organization t ON t.org_id = o.org_id AND t.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} GROUP BY o.org_id, o.parent_org_id, o.org_name, o.org_level, o.org_index, t.org_id ORDER BY o.org_level, o.org_index, o.org_id

WITH RECURSIVE branch(org_id) AS ( SELECT org_id FROM byai.po_organization WHERE org_id = #{orgId} UNION ALL SELECT child.org_id FROM byai.po_organization child JOIN branch parent ON child.parent_org_id = parent.org_id ) SELECT org_id FROM branch

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS "userId", u.user_code AS "userCode", u.user_name AS "userName" FROM byai.po_users_organization rel JOIN byai.po_users u ON u.user_id = rel.user_id WHERE u.state = 'A' AND rel.org_id IN #{orgId} ORDER BY "userId"
SELECT org_id FROM byai.tenant_organization WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO byai.tenant_organization (enterprise_id, org_id, added_by) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{orgId}, #{addedBy})
